sourcePolicy.method: Manual inspection of IIT Roorkee official Academic Affairs fee schedule and Board of Governors UG Ordinance; public pages/PDFs opened directly, no automated bulk requests or access-control bypass.
sourcePolicy.factualUse: Stage only concise exact fee-component/category values and UG admission route, year-labelled and linked. Exclude total grand totals, deposits, mess advance and untyped cost categories; no PDF or source prose stored.
sourcePolicy.reuseConditions: Public visibility does not establish bulk redistribution permission. No explicit source licence was identified. Individual source-backed fact staging is internal and unreviewed; no bulk extraction or document reproduction permission is inferred. Reviewer must inspect originals and confirm intended use.

researchDisposition.note: Official schedule separates annual academic year, first-year UG tuition categories, accommodation and electricity. Table totals, refundable deposits, mess advance (subject to adjustment), and zero amounts were not imported as fees. Tuition remissions are staged as aid/waiver with clear scope. 2026-27 scholarship application deadlines found in separate notices have elapsed, so no live application link or current-open claim is asserted.
